description: Python dependency files that do not have a sibling uv.lock yet, so the python-dependency-audit CI job does not audit them. infra/test/ci/pythonDependencyLocks.test.ts fails a Python dependency file (pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt/.in/.lock, Pipfile, setup.py with install_requires) the audit does not cover unless it is listed here with a reason and the change that will add the lock. Remove an entry when its uv.lock lands; the test fails an entry whose path is gone or already has a uv.lock.
